description: Figure 9 is a bar chart that illustrates the effect of context masking perturbations on model performance, categorized by part-of-speech (POS) tag. The horizontal axis lists the different tags, including NOUN, VERB, ADJ, ADV, PRON, DET, ADP, NUM, PRT, and CONJ, arranged in a specific order. The vertical axis represents the effect of the perturbation, measured as a percentage of the original accuracy, with a scale ranging from -10% to 40%. Each bar corresponds to a specific tag and its height indicates the average effect of the perturbation, with error bars showing the standard deviation. The chart shows that proper nouns (NOUN) are the most affected by context masking, with an effect of approximately 35%. Verbs (VERB) are the least affected, with an effect close to 0%. Other tags like ADJ, ADV, and PRON show moderate effects, while tags like DET, ADP, NUM, PRT, and CONJ have smaller effects, with some showing a slight negative effect. The error bars for most tags are relatively small, indicating low variability in the results.
